original.target_description: Experiment 2: achievement-goal-primed versus control Hebrew University undergraduates; between-group t test of implicit serial reaction time learning, defined as average RT in two random test blocks minus average RT in the fixed-sequence block.

n.sample_role: Participants in the analytic sample for the Experiment 2 learning comparison; Table 2 group headers give goal-priming n = 41 and control n = 45.
n.exclusions: 93 recruited; 6 excluded for suspecting the goal-priming procedure, and 1 excluded because the learning score was 4 standard deviations from the group mean.
n.location: Published p. 264 (PDF p. 4), Experiment 2, Results and Discussion; p. 265, Table 2 group headers.
n.quote: findings reported here are based on data from 86 participants

es.location: Published p. 265 (PDF p. 5), Experiment 2, Learning, paragraph beginning "To test this effect statistically".

p.location: Published p. 265 (PDF p. 5), Experiment 2, Learning, same t(84) test; p_rep only.

replication.target_description: Nonconscious goal pursuit in novel environments: The case of implicit learning.; replicated study 2; goal primed participants learned more than participants in the control group; Independent samples t-test

n.sample_role: N (R), project authors’ replication sample size; analytic role not independently documented
n.location: Primary rpp_data.csv, CSV data row 108 (header row 1), Study Num 107, column N (R)

es.location: Primary rpp_data.csv, CSV data row 108 (header row 1), Study Num 107, column Effect Size (R)

p.location: Primary rpp_data.csv, CSV data row 108 (header row 1), Study Num 107, column P-value (R)

reported_success.location: Primary rpp_data.csv, CSV data row 108 (header row 1), Study Num 107, column Replicate (R)

notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table entries; no metric conversion performed. N (R) is retained as named, with exclusions unknown. Primary table URL https://osf.io/edcr7/; assigned locator https://osf.io/x75fq.
Source follow-up: Original-only extraction from supplied published article, with matching title and authors. Input p. 5 corresponds to printed p. 265. For the target test the article prints p_rep = .92, not an ordinary significance p value; p is null and no conversion was performed. Source text renders equals signs as "5". Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
